purpose: Pure scan-payload classification + destination resolution: given a decoded QR-scan string, classify it as a contact/pairing card or a group invite and return the app-relative destination to navigate to, or null. Owns the existing generation + card-validation seam plus the new group-invite shape validator.

public_api.name: resolveScanDestination
public_api.description: The ScanDestination seam (stories.json seams[0]). Card branch delegates to normaliseScanPayload -> parseContactCard (decode + signature verification, unchanged). Group-invite branch is new: shape-validates an absolute URL whose pathname is the /groups/ invite path, a well-formed hex join nonce, an admin that decodes via npubToPubkeyHex, and a non-empty name — origin-agnostic (AC-ROUTE-6). Returns '/add#c=<payload>', '/groups?join=&admin=&name=', or null. Synchronous, pure, DOM-free, never throws.

public_api.name: normaliseScanPayload
public_api.description: Existing (unmodified) — card decode + signature verification seam this story's card branch delegates to.

public_api.name: canUseCameraQrScanner
public_api.description: Existing (unmodified) — camera capability probe, consumed by S2.

public_api.name: generateQrDataUrl
public_api.description: Existing (unmodified) — QR generation seam, unrelated to this story.
